interpretations: For each driver with at least one race result where `grid >= 12`, sum the nonmissing `points` and average the nonmissing `laps` from those results; return one row containing the unrounded average of those driver points totals and the unrounded average of those driver lap averages.
queries:
SELECT
    AVG(driver_points_total),
    AVG(driver_lap_average)
FROM (
    SELECT
        driverId,
        SUM(points) AS driver_points_total,
        AVG(
            CASE
                WHEN laps GLOB '[0-9]*'
                 AND laps NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
                THEN CAST(laps AS REAL)
            END
        ) AS driver_lap_average
    FROM results
    WHERE grid >= 12
    GROUP BY driverId
)
